questions.subtopic: Case Analysis: Chinese Toys in Indian Bazaars

Consumers faced severe shortages while domestic toy makers became MNCs
Neither group experienced any economic change
Consumers gained greater variety and lower prices, while domestic toy makers suffered heavy business contraction and job losses
questions.explanation: Consumers gained a wider choice and lower prices, while Indian toy makers faced losses because their products sold much less. questions.question: Under WTO rules, which statement best describes dumping and the basis for an anti-dumping measure?
options: Dumping means disposing of hazardous waste in international waters; anti-dumping duties regulate shipping pollution

Dumping generally involves exporting a product at a price below its comparable normal value in the exporting country; an anti-dumping duty requires an investigation establishing dumping, material injury or threat, and a causal link
Dumping means any import priced below the domestic retail price; an anti-dumping duty can be imposed automatically without investigation
Dumping means that a government prohibits all imports of a product
questions.explanation: Under WTO anti-dumping rules, the comparison is generally between the export price and the comparable price in the ordinary course of trade in the exporting country (or an authorised constructed/comparable value). A duty is not automatic: the investigation must establish dumping, material injury or threat to the domestic industry, and a causal link. This is supplementary trade-law detail, beyond the chapter’s core treatment.
